note: Nordea's four personal credit cards in Finland, each from its own page (read 2026-10-30): the Nordea Credit (2.99 euros a month), Nordea Gold (5.99 a month, the card's 2.99 and its added services), Nordea Platinum (16.99 a month to personal customers) and Stockmann Mastercard (no opening or annual fee; for MyStockmann members). Each lends at the 3-month Euribor plus a margin (14.90%, 13.90%, 9.5% and 12.5%), written as their sum on the Euribor Nordea's own examples give, 2.08% in April 2026: 16.98%, 15.98%, 11.58% and 14.58% a year. Each gives 30 days without interest for card payments (the Stockmann card's page says 30 on average), written as grace of 30, and adds 2.50% to the exchange rate on a purchase or withdrawal in a currency other than the euro. A cash withdrawal on the card credit bears interest from the day it's taken, with no withdrawal fee stated, so no cash fee is written. Cheaper monthly prices inside service packages (Blue, Platinum, Private Banking) aren't written, the game holding no package; the student card page offers the Nordea Gold. The main banks: Nordea, OP and Danske Bank are Finland's largest; OP's credit card page wasn't found at its address on 2026-10-30 and Danske Bank's Finnish cards weren't reached, so only Nordea is written. The earlier reading of the Nordea Credit (2026-10-29) holds and is kept.
